Mira (Finance): Heads-up  Aurora Bio opened a dispute on INV-2026-1107-9001. They say a trial org migration duplicated historical usage into their production account, causing a large overage charge. Ticket SUP-5320. Asking for partial refund of the overage + a small goodwill credit.

Owen (Support): Customer included export showing migrated runs with ids: migrated_run_01..migrated_run_12 that overlap with existing runs. They claim the migrated records should have been flagged as historical (no-charge).

Samir (Engineering): Quick audit of the usage export: `SELECT run_id, tokens, imported_at FROM usage_imports WHERE run_id LIKE 'migrated_run_%' ORDER BY imported_at LIMIT 20;`
Results show 12 migrated runs imported on 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06, total tokens = 3,120,000. Matching runs exist in production with tokens ~3,118,800. Looks like duplicates were created during migration.

Billing Bot: Invoice INV-2026-1107-9001 total $9,720.00. Line item bulk-ingest overage $3,120.00 appears to correspond to duplicated migrated usage. Suggested adjustment code ADJ-8955 and potential refund amount $3,120.00.

Riley (Sales): Aurora is in a strategic trial-to-paid transition (~projected $50k ARR). Recommend refunding the duplicated usage $3,120 and applying a $350 goodwill credit to next invoice to smooth the transition. Also offer a free migration review session.

Mira (Finance): I can approve a manual adjustment ADJ-8955 for $3,120. For the $350 goodwill credit, approve PROMO-AURORA-350 as non-recurring. Please put a brief memo: "migration duplicate usage refund + goodwill credit".

Samir (Engineering): Will create the adjustment PR and attach import logs. Planned API call: `POST /internal/billing/adjustments {"invoice":"INV-2026-1107-9001","amount":-3120,"reason":"migration duplicate usage refund","code":"ADJ-8955"}`. I'll also mark the imported records with tag `historical_no_charge` to prevent future billing and open CH-1368 to improve migration import dedupe.

Owen (Support): Notified customer: "We're processing a $3,120 refund for duplicated migrated usage and applying a $350 goodwill credit to your next invoice. Refund should appear in 3-7 business days." Customer replied with :relieved: and asked for the adjustment reference for their AP team.

Mira (Finance): Adding refund reference REF-AP-2026-1108-AUR and generating promo PROMO-AURORA-350. ADJ-8955 created and queued as non-recurring.

Billing Bot: Adjustment ADJ-8955 posted to ledger on 2026-11-09. Invoice INV-2026-1107-9001 updated; PROMO-AURORA-350 applied. Customer notification queued with refund reference REF-AP-2026-1108-AUR.

Riley (Sales): I'll schedule the migration review and note the incident in CRM under the trial playbook.

Samir (Engineering): CH-1368 opened to add idempotent import checks and a preflight report for future migrations. Attaching logs to ADJ-8955 PR.

Mira (Finance): Closing once refund processes in bank. Thanks team.
